title: Do / did / done
descriptionFa: عبارت‌های پرکاربرد با do برای کارها و فعالیت‌ها، و جواب‌های کوتاه.

words.example: I did all my homework before dinner.
words.tipFa: سه شکل: do / did / done. سؤال گذشته هم با did: Did you like the film?

words.example: What are you doing? I'm cooking dinner.
words.tipFa: با What do you do? (شغلت چیه؟) فرق داره.

words.example: Don't do that! You'll break it.
I love chocolate. So do I!
words.tipFa: برای گذشته: So did I. برای منفی: Neither do I (منم نه).

words.example: My husband and I do the housework together.
I do the washing on Mondays.
words.tipFa: the washing = لباس‌ها؛ the washing-up = ظرف‌ها.

words.example: On Friday mornings I do the gardening.

words.meaningFa: نرمش کردن، چند تا حرکت ورزشی انجام دادن
words.example: I do some exercises every morning before work.
Our company wants to do business with China.
Don't worry about the exam. Just do your best.
words.tipFa: با ضمیر عوض می‌شه: I'll do my best, she did her best.
